## RYANAIR ADDS 4 NEW ROUTES FROM LEEDS BRADFORD FOR SUMMER 2027


### GIVING CUSTOMERS THE CHANCE TO BOOK EARLY AND AVAIL OF THE LOWEST FARES


Ryanair, the UK’s No.1 low fares airline, has today (Thurs, 19 Nov) announced 4 exciting new Summer 2027 routes from Leeds Bradford to Bari, Budapest, Corfu and Tirana, all of which will operate twice per week from 29 Mar 2027.


From Mediterranean coastlines to vibrant European city breaks, Ryanair’s new Leeds Bradford routes provide customers with even more choice for their next summer getaway at the lowest fares in Europe. Bari offers visitors a charming old quarter, vibrant waterfront, and an authentic southern Italian experience, while Budapest is renowned for its stunning architecture, famous thermal spas, and vibrant atmosphere. For those seeking both sun and sea, Corfu offers crystal-clear waters, an authentic Mediterranean culinary experience and a rich cultural heritage, while Tirana is known for its colourful streets, fascinating history, and easy access to Albania’s breathtaking natural landscapes.


Ryanair’s 4 new Summer 2027 routes to/from Leeds Bradford are available to book now via the Ryanair app/website.


**Ryanair’s Director of Comms, Jade Kirwan, said:**


*“Although we have not yet launched our full Summer 2027 schedule, Ryanair is giving our UK customers in the North a sneak peek at what new routes we will be offering with the announcement of these 4 exciting new Summer 2027 routes from Leeds Bradford to* *Bari, Budapest, Corfu and Tirana. Each of these new Ryanair routes will operate twice per week from 29 Mar 2027, giving our Yorkshire customers even more low-fare choice and regular connections for their Summer 2027 getaways. Tickets are available to book via Ryanair’s app/website now.”*

Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (1st August) celebrated the first flight from Prague to Paphos, while on Monday (3rd August) it will launch a twice weekly service to Kosice, both as part of its extended Summer 2020 schedule.


To celebrate its new routes, Ryanair has launched a seat sale with fares from 729 Kc for travel to Kosice and from 759 Kc to Paphos, both until the end of October, which must be booked by Wednesday (5th August), only on the Ryanair.com website.
